caseName: Union Cartage Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: UNION CARTAGE CO. v. UNITED STATES
attorneys: Earl R. Stanley for appellant., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Loevinger, Richard A. Solomon and Robert W. Ginnane for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Brennan are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
